targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "moisture")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "sensor-1")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "moisture")
  |> elapsed(unit: 1m, timeColumn: "_time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.elapsed > 15)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, gap: r.elapsed, device_id: r.device_id}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gap < 240)

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_f" or r._field == "humidity")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${__interval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
